verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּימֵי֙ אַמְרָפֶ֣ל מֶֽלֶךְ־ שִׁנְעָ֔ר אַרְי֖וֹךְ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֶלָּסָ֑ר כְּדָרְלָעֹ֙מֶר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֵילָ֔ם וְתִדְעָ֖ל מֶ֥לֶךְ גּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bî·mê ’am·rā·p̄el me·leḵ- šin·‘ār ’ar·yō·wḵ me·leḵ ’el·lā·sār kə·ḏā·rə·lā·‘ō·mer me·leḵ ‘ê·lām wə·ṯiḏ·‘āl me·leḵ gō·w·yim
verses.literal: - In those days Amraphel king of Shinar Arioch king of Ellasar Chedorlaomer king of Elam and Tidal king of Goiim

verses.original: עָשׂ֣וּ מִלְחָמָ֗ה אֶת־ בֶּ֙רַע֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ סְדֹ֔ם וְאֶת־ בִּרְשַׁ֖ע מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲמֹרָ֑ה שִׁנְאָ֣ב׀ מֶ֣לֶךְ אַדְמָ֗ה וְשֶׁמְאֵ֙בֶר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ צְבֹיִים וּמֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּ֖לַע הִיא־ צֹֽעַר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·śū mil·ḥā·māh ’eṯ- be·ra‘ me·leḵ sə·ḏōm wə·’eṯ- bir·ša‘ me·leḵ ‘ă·mō·rāh šin·’āḇ me·leḵ ’aḏ·māh wə·šem·’ê·ḇer me·leḵ ṣə·ḇō·yīm ū·me·leḵ be·la‘ hî- ṣō·‘ar
verses.literal: went to war against Bera king of Sodom . . . Birsha king of Gomorrah Shinab king of Admah Shemeber king of Zeboiim and the king of Bela (that is Zoar)

verses.original: אֵ֙לֶּה֙ כָּל־ חָֽבְר֔וּ אֶל־ עֵ֖מֶק הַשִּׂדִּ֑ים ה֖וּא הַמֶּֽלַח׃ יָ֥ם
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh kāl- ḥā·ḇə·rū ’el- ‘ê·meq haś·śid·dîm hū ham·me·laḥ yām
verses.literal: The latter [five] came as allies to the Valley of Siddim (that is the Salt Sea

verses.original: שְׁתֵּ֤ים עֶשְׂרֵה֙ שָׁנָ֔ה עָבְד֖וּ אֶת־ כְּדָרְלָעֹ֑מֶר וּשְׁלֹשׁ־ עֶשְׂרֵ֥ה שָׁנָ֖ה מָרָֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·têm ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh ‘ā·ḇə·ḏū ’eṯ- kə·ḏā·rə·lā·‘ō·mer ū·šə·lōš- ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh mā·rā·ḏū
verses.literal: For twelve . . . years they had been subject - to Chedorlaomer but in the thirteenth . . . year they rebelled

verses.original: וּבְאַרְבַּע֩ עֶשְׂרֵ֨ה שָׁנָ֜ה כְדָרְלָעֹ֗מֶר וְהַמְּלָכִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֔וֹ בָּ֣א וַיַּכּ֤וּ אֶת־ רְפָאִים֙ בְּעַשְׁתְּרֹ֣ת קַרְנַ֔יִם וְאֶת־ הַזּוּזִ֖ים בְּהָ֑ם וְאֵת֙ הָֽאֵימִ֔ים בְּשָׁוֵ֖ה קִרְיָתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·’ar·ba‘ ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh ḵə·ḏā·rə·lā·‘ō·mer wə·ham·mə·lā·ḵîm ’ă·šer ’it·tōw bā way·yak·kū ’eṯ- rə·p̄ā·’îm bə·‘aš·tə·rōṯ qar·na·yim wə·’eṯ- haz·zū·zîm bə·hām wə·’êṯ hā·’ê·mîm bə·šā·wêh qir·yā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: In the fourteenth . . . year Chedorlaomer and the kings - allied with him went out and defeated - the Rephaites in Ashteroth-karnaim - the Zuzites in Ham - the Emites in Shaveh-kiriathaim . . .

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַחֹרִ֖י בְּהַרְרָ֣ם שֵׂעִ֑יר עַ֚ד אֵ֣יל פָּארָ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥō·rî bə·har·rām śê·‘îr ‘aḏ ’êl pā·rān ’ă·šer ‘al- ham·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: and the Horites in [the area of] Mount Seir as far as vvv El-paran which [is] near the desert

verses.original: וַ֠יָּשֻׁבוּ וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ אֶל־ עֵ֤ין מִשְׁפָּט֙ הִ֣וא קָדֵ֔שׁ וַיַּכּ֕וּ אֶֽת־ כָּל־ שְׂדֵ֖ה הָעֲמָלֵקִ֑י וְגַם֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י הַיֹּשֵׁ֖ב בְּחַֽצְצֹ֥ן תָּמָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šu·ḇū way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- ‘ên miš·pāṭ hî qā·ḏêš way·yak·kū ’eṯ- kāl- śə·ḏêh hā·‘ă·mā·lê·qî wə·ḡam ’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·mō·rî hay·yō·šêḇ bə·ḥaṣ·ṣōn tā·mār
verses.literal: Then they turned back to invade . . . vvv En-mishpat (that is Kadesh) and they conquered - the whole territory of the Amalekites as - well as the Amorites who lived vvv in Hazazon-tamar

verses.original: מֶֽלֶךְ־ סְדֹ֜ם וּמֶ֣לֶךְ עֲמֹרָ֗ה וּמֶ֤לֶךְ אַדְמָה֙ וּמֶ֣לֶךְ צְבֹיִים וּמֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּ֖לַע הִוא־ צֹ֑עַר וַיֵּצֵ֨א וַיַּֽעַרְכ֤וּ אִתָּם֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּעֵ֖מֶק הַשִּׂדִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ- sə·ḏōm ū·me·leḵ ‘ă·mō·rāh ū·me·leḵ ’aḏ·māh ū·me·leḵ ṣə·ḇō·yīm ū·me·leḵ be·la‘ hî ṣō·‘ar way·yê·ṣê way·ya·‘ar·ḵū ’it·tām mil·ḥā·māh bə·‘ê·meq haś·śid·dîm
verses.literal: Then the king of Sodom the king of Gomorrah the king of Admah the king of Zeboiim and the king of Bela (that is Zoar marched out and arrayed themselves for battle in the Valley of Siddim

verses.original: אֵ֣ת כְּדָרְלָעֹ֜מֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ עֵילָ֗ם וְתִדְעָל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ גּוֹיִ֔ם וְאַמְרָפֶל֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ שִׁנְעָ֔ר וְאַרְי֖וֹךְ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֶלָּסָ֑ר אַרְבָּעָ֥ה מְלָכִ֖ים אֶת־ הַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: ’êṯ kə·ḏā·rə·lā·‘ō·mer me·leḵ ‘ê·lām wə·ṯiḏ·‘āl me·leḵ gō·w·yim wə·’am·rā·p̄el me·leḵ šin·‘ār wə·’ar·yō·wḵ me·leḵ ’el·lā·sār ’ar·bā·‘āh mə·lā·ḵîm ’eṯ- ha·ḥă·miš·šāh
verses.literal: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam Tidal king of Goiim Amraphel king of Shinar and Arioch king of Ellasar four kings against five

verses.original: וְעֵ֣מֶק הַשִׂדִּ֗ים חֵמָ֔ר בֶּֽאֱרֹ֤ת בֶּאֱרֹת֙ מֶֽלֶךְ־ סְדֹ֥ם וַעֲמֹרָ֖ה וַיָּנֻ֛סוּ וַיִּפְּלוּ־ שָׁ֑מָּה וְהַנִּשְׁאָרִ֖ים נָּֽסוּ׃ הֶ֥רָה
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ê·meq ha·śid·dīm ḥê·mār be·’ĕ·rōṯ be·’ĕ·rōṯ me·leḵ- sə·ḏōm wa·‘ă·mō·rāh way·yā·nu·sū way·yip·pə·lū- šām·māh wə·han·niš·’ā·rîm nā·sū he·rāh
verses.literal: Now the Valley of Siddim was full of tar pits . . . and as the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled some men fell into [the pits] but the survivors fled to the hill country

verses.original: וַ֠יִּקְחוּ אֶת־ כָּל־ רְכֻ֨שׁ סְדֹ֧ם וַעֲמֹרָ֛ה וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אָכְלָ֖ם וַיֵּלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ḥū ’eṯ- kāl- rə·ḵuš sə·ḏōm wa·‘ă·mō·rāh wə·’eṯ- kāl- ’ā·ḵə·lām way·yê·lê·ḵū
verses.literal: The [four kings] seized - all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah - and all their food and they went on their way

verses.original: וַיִּקְח֨וּ אֶת־ וַיֵּלֵ֑כוּ אַבְרָ֖ם בֶּן־ אֲחִ֥י ל֧וֹט וְאֶת־ רְכֻשׁ֛וֹ וְה֥וּא יֹשֵׁ֖ב בִּסְדֹֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ḥū ’eṯ- way·yê·lê·ḵū ’aḇ·rām ben- ’ă·ḥî lō·wṭ wə·’eṯ- rə·ḵu·šōw wə·hū yō·šêḇ bis·ḏōm
verses.literal: They also carried off - - Abram’s nephew . . . Lot - and his possessions since [Lot] was living in Sodom

verses.original: הַפָּלִ֔יט וַיָּבֹא֙ וַיַּגֵּ֖ד לְאַבְרָ֣ם הָעִבְרִ֑י וְהוּא֩ שֹׁכֵ֨ן בְּאֵֽלֹנֵ֜י מַמְרֵ֣א הָאֱמֹרִ֗י אֲחִ֤י אֶשְׁכֹּל֙ וַאֲחִ֣י עָנֵ֔ר וְהֵ֖ם בַּעֲלֵ֥י בְרִית־ אַבְרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hap·pā·lîṭ way·yā·ḇō way·yag·gêḏ lə·’aḇ·rām hā·‘iḇ·rî wə·hū šō·ḵên bə·’ê·lō·nê mam·rê hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ’ă·ḥî ’eš·kōl wa·’ă·ḥî ‘ā·nêr wə·hêm ba·‘ă·lê ḇə·rîṯ- ’aḇ·rām
verses.literal: Then an escapee came and reported [this] to Abram the Hebrew Now [Abram] was living near the Oaks of Mamre the Amorite a brother of Eshcol [and] Aner all of whom were bound by treaty to Abram

verses.original: אַבְרָ֔ם וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע כִּ֥י אָחִ֑יו נִשְׁבָּ֖ה וַיָּ֨רֶק אֶת־ שְׁמֹנָ֤ה עָשָׂר֙ וּשְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת חֲנִיכָ֜יו יְלִידֵ֣י בֵית֗וֹ וַיִּרְדֹּ֖ף עַד־ דָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḇ·rām way·yiš·ma‘ kî ’ā·ḥîw niš·bāh way·yā·req ’eṯ- šə·mō·nāh ‘ā·śār ū·šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ ḥă·nî·ḵāw yə·lî·ḏê ḇê·ṯōw way·yir·dōp̄ ‘aḏ- dān
verses.literal: And when Abram heard that his relative had been captured he mobilized - the 318 . . . . . . . . . trained men born in his household and they set out in pursuit as far as Dan

verses.original: לַ֛יְלָה ה֥וּא וַיֵּחָלֵ֨ק עֲלֵיהֶ֧ם׀ וַעֲבָדָ֖יו וַיַּכֵּ֑ם וַֽיִּרְדְּפֵם֙ עַד־ חוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִשְּׂמֹ֖אל לְדַמָּֽשֶׂק׃
verses.transliteration: lay·lāh hū way·yê·ḥā·lêq ‘ă·lê·hem wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw way·yak·kêm way·yir·də·p̄êm ‘aḏ- ḥō·w·ḇāh ’ă·šer miś·śə·mōl lə·ḏam·mā·śeq
verses.literal: During the night [Abram] divided . . . his forces and routed [Chedorlaomer’s army] pursuing them as far as Hobah - north of Damascus

verses.original: וַיָּ֕שֶׁב אֵ֖ת כָּל־ הָרְכֻ֑שׁ וְגַם֩ אֶת־ אָחִ֤יו ל֨וֹט וּרְכֻשׁוֹ֙ הֵשִׁ֔יב וְגַ֥ם אֶת־ הַנָּשִׁ֖ים וְאֶת־ הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šeḇ ’êṯ kāl- hā·rə·ḵuš wə·ḡam ’eṯ- ’ā·ḥîw lō·wṭ ū·rə·ḵu·šōw hê·šîḇ wə·ḡam ’eṯ- han·nā·šîm wə·’eṯ- hā·‘ām
verses.literal: He retrieved - all the goods as well as - his relative Lot and his possessions . . . together with - the women - and the rest of the people

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֣י שׁוּב֗וֹ מֵֽהַכּוֹת֙ אֶת־ כְּדָר־ לָעֹ֔מֶר וְאֶת־ הַמְּלָכִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִתּ֑וֹ מֶֽלֶךְ־ סְדֹם֮ וַיֵּצֵ֣א לִקְרָאתוֹ֒ אֶל־ עֵ֣מֶק שָׁוֵ֔ה ה֖וּא הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ עֵ֥מֶק
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rê šū·ḇōw mê·hak·kō·wṯ ’eṯ- kə·ḏå̄r- lå̄·ʿō·mɛr wə·’eṯ- ham·mə·lā·ḵîm ’ă·šer ’it·tōw me·leḵ- sə·ḏōm way·yê·ṣê liq·rā·ṯōw ’el- ‘ê·meq šā·wêh hū ham·me·leḵ ‘ê·meq
verses.literal: After Abram returned from defeating - vvv Chedorlaomer - and the kings vvv allied with him the king of Sodom went out to meet him in the Valley of Shaveh (that is the King’s Valley)

verses.original: וּמַלְכִּי־ צֶ֙דֶק֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ שָׁלֵ֔ם הוֹצִ֖יא לֶ֣חֶם וָיָ֑יִן וְה֥וּא כֹהֵ֖ן לְאֵ֥ל עֶלְיֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mal·kî- ṣe·ḏeq me·leḵ šā·lêm hō·w·ṣî le·ḥem wā·yā·yin wə·hū ḵō·hên lə·’êl ‘el·yō·wn
verses.literal: vvv Then Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine since he was priest of God Most High

verses.original: וַֽיְבָרְכֵ֖הוּ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר בָּר֤וּךְ אַבְרָם֙ לְאֵ֣ל עֶלְי֔וֹן קֹנֵ֖ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇā·rə·ḵê·hū way·yō·mar bā·rūḵ ’aḇ·rām lə·’êl ‘el·yō·wn qō·nêh šā·ma·yim wā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: and he blessed [Abram] and said Blessed be Abram by God Most High Creator of heaven and earth

verses.original: וּבָרוּךְ֙ אֵ֣ל עֶלְי֔וֹן אֲשֶׁר־ מִגֵּ֥ן צָרֶ֖יךָ בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וַיִּתֶּן־ ל֥וֹ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ר מִכֹּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·rūḵ ’êl ‘el·yō·wn ’ă·šer- mig·gên ṣā·re·ḵā bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā way·yit·ten- lōw ma·‘ă·śêr mik·kōl
verses.literal: and blessed be God Most High who has delivered your enemies into your hand Then Abram gave [Melchizedek] a tenth of everything

verses.original: מֶֽלֶךְ־ סְדֹ֖ם וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ אַבְרָ֑ם תֶּן־ לִ֣י הַנֶּ֔פֶשׁ קַֽח־ וְהָרְכֻ֖שׁ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ- sə·ḏōm way·yō·mer ’el- ’aḇ·rām ten- lî han·ne·p̄eš qaḥ- wə·hā·rə·ḵuš lāḵ
verses.literal: The king of Sodom said to Abram Give me the people but take the goods for yourself

verses.original: אַבְרָ֖ם וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ סְדֹ֑ם הֲרִימֹ֨תִי יָדִ֤י אֶל־ יְהוָה֙ אֵ֣ל עֶלְי֔וֹן קֹנֵ֖ה שָׁמַ֥יִם וָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḇ·rām way·yō·mer ’el- me·leḵ sə·ḏōm hă·rî·mō·ṯî yā·ḏî ’el- Yah·weh ’êl ‘el·yō·wn qō·nêh šā·ma·yim wā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: But Abram replied to the king of Sodom I have raised my hand to the LORD God Most High Creator of heaven and earth

verses.original: אִם־ וְאִם־ אֶקַּ֖ח וְעַ֣ד מִחוּט֙ שְׂרֽוֹךְ־ נַ֔עַל מִכָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לָ֑ךְ וְלֹ֣א תֹאמַ֔ר אֲנִ֖י אַבְרָֽם׃ אֶת־ הֶעֱשַׁ֥רְתִּי
verses.transliteration: ’im- wə·’im- ’eq·qaḥ wə·‘aḏ mi·ḥūṭ śə·rō·wḵ- na·‘al mik·kāl ’ă·šer- lāḵ wə·lō ṯō·mar ’ă·nî ’aḇ·rām ’eṯ- he·‘ĕ·šar·tî
verses.literal: that I will not accept even a thread or a strap of a sandal or anything that belongs to you lest you should say I {have made} Abram - rich

verses.original: בִּלְעָדַ֗י רַ֚ק אֲשֶׁ֣ר הַנְּעָרִ֔ים אָֽכְל֣וּ וְחֵ֙לֶק֙ הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלְכ֖וּ אִתִּ֑י עָנֵר֙ אֶשְׁכֹּ֣ל וּמַמְרֵ֔א הֵ֖ם יִקְח֥וּ חֶלְקָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: bil·‘ā·ḏay raq ’ă·šer han·nə·‘ā·rîm ’ā·ḵə·lū wə·ḥê·leq hā·’ă·nā·šîm ’ă·šer hā·lə·ḵū ’it·tî ‘ā·nêr ’eš·kōl ū·mam·rê hêm yiq·ḥū ḥel·qām
verses.literal: I will accept nothing but what my men have eaten and the share for the men who went with me Aner Eshcol and Mamre They may take their portion
